prompt.en: The cat is sitting on top of the almirah. Is the cat up or down?
prompt.hi: Billi almari ke upar baithi hai. Billi upar hai ya neeche?

challenges.hint: Is the cat on the almirah or under it?

prompt.en: The ball is in the basket. Is the ball inside or outside?
prompt.hi: Ball tokri mein hai. Ball andar hai ya bahar?

challenges.hint: If you look into the basket, will you see the ball?

prompt.en: I put a laddoo on top of a closed dabba lid. Guess first: if I open the dabba, will the laddoo be inside?
prompt.hi: Main ek laddoo band dabbe ke dhakkan ke upar rakhti hoon. Pehle guess karo: dabba kholenge to laddoo andar milega?

challenges.hint: The lid was closed. Could the laddoo get in?

prompt.en: Two rows with 4 laddoos each. I will spread one row out wide. Guess first: will it have more, fewer, or the same?
prompt.hi: Do line hain, dono mein 4-4 laddoo. Main ek line ko door-door phaila doongi. Pehle guess karo: zyada honge, kam, ya utne hi?

prompt.en: Each child gets one roti. There are 4 children and 3 rotis. Are there enough rotis?
prompt.hi: Har bachche ko ek roti milegi. 4 bachche hain aur 3 rotiyaan. Kya rotiyaan kaafi hain?

challenges.hint: After 3 children get a roti, how many children are still waiting?

prompt.en: Bholu puts 5 marbles close together and 5 marbles far apart. He says the far-apart ones are more. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Bholu 5 kanche paas-paas rakhta hai aur 5 kanche door-door. Woh kehta hai door wale zyada hain. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Does spreading them add a marble?

prompt.en: Teach Chintu: if he spreads out his laddoos on the plate, does he get more laddoos?
prompt.hi: Chintu ko samjhao: agar woh plate pe apne laddoo phaila de, to kya laddoo zyada ho jaayenge?

challenges.hint: What would he have to do to really get more laddoos?

prompt.en: Rajma, chana and moong are mixed in a katori. How many groups will you make?
prompt.hi: Ek katori mein rajma, chana aur moong mix hain. Kitne group banaoge?

prompt.en: A long pencil is lying down. I stand it up. Guess first: is it still long?
prompt.hi: Ek lambi pencil leti hui hai. Main use khada kar deti hoon. Pehle guess karo: kya ab bhi lambi hai?

challenges.hint: Are the two ends still the same distance apart?

prompt.en: Is a one-rupee coin round or long?
prompt.hi: Ek rupaye ka sikka gol hai ya lamba?

prompt.en: A water bottle: is it long, round, or both?
prompt.hi: Paani ki bottle: lambi hai, gol hai, ya dono?

challenges.hint: Now look at it from the top. What shape is the cap?

prompt.en: Can you make a tower with matchboxes?
prompt.hi: Kya maachis ki dibbiyon se tower bana sakte ho?

prompt.en: A matchbox is on a slanting notebook. Will it roll or slide?
prompt.hi: Maachis ki dibbi tedhi copy pe rakhi hai. Woh lurhkegi ya phisalegi?

challenges.hint: Is that part flat or curved?

prompt.en: I lay a water bottle on its side on a slope. Guess first: will it roll?
prompt.hi: Main paani ki bottle ko karvat se dhalaan pe rakhti hoon. Pehle guess karo: lurhkegi?

prompt.en: Bholu says ghee tins cannot be stacked because they are round. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Bholu kehta hai ghee ke dibbe upar-neeche nahi rakh sakte kyunki woh gol hain. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Will an orange roll or slide?
prompt.hi: Santra lurhkega ya phisalega?

prompt.en: Count with me from 1. What comes after 4?
prompt.hi: Mere saath 1 se gino. 4 ke baad kya aata hai?

prompt.en: 1 mango, 2 mangoes, 3 mangoes. How many mangoes in all?
prompt.hi: 1 aam, 2 aam, 3 aam. Kul kitne aam?

prompt.en: Count the fingers on one of your hands. How many?
prompt.hi: Apne ek haath ki ungliyaan gino. Kitni hain?

prompt.en: There are lots of rotis. Give 4 rotis to Dadi. When do you stop counting?
prompt.hi: Bahut saari rotiyaan hain. Dadi ko 4 rotiyaan do. Ginna kab rokoge?

prompt.en: Bholu counts 4 mangoes but touches one mango two times. He says 5. What went wrong?
prompt.hi: Bholu 4 aam ginta hai par ek aam ko do baar chhoo leta hai. Woh kehta hai 5. Kya galat hua?

challenges.hint: Bholu touched one mango how many times?

prompt.en: Count my claps: clap, clap, clap, clap. How many claps?
prompt.hi: Meri taaliyaan gino: taali, taali, taali, taali. Kitni taaliyaan?

prompt.en: 4 cousins are coming over. Each one gets 1 mango. How many mangoes should you take out of the basket?
prompt.hi: 4 cousins aa rahe hain. Har ek ko 1 aam milega. Tokri se kitne aam nikaaloge?

challenges.hint: Take one mango for each cousin as you count.

prompt.en: 1 kite, 2 kites, 3 kites, 4 kites, 5 kites, 6 kites. How many kites?
prompt.hi: 1 patang, 2 patang, 3, 4, 5, 6 patang. Kitni patang?

prompt.en: Clap, clap, clap, clap. Which number is that?
prompt.hi: Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?

prompt.en: Which number is called "seven"? Say it in Hindi too.
prompt.hi: "Seven" kaun sa number hai? Hindi mein bhi bolo.

prompt.en: There were 2 rotis. You ate both. How many rotis are left?
prompt.hi: 2 rotiyaan thi. Tumne dono kha li. Kitni bachi?

challenges.hint: You ate both. Is any roti left on the plate?

prompt.en: Bholu wrote his house number, 6, upside down. He says it is still six. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Bholu ne apna ghar ka number 6 ulta likh diya. Woh kehta hai yeh ab bhi chhah hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Which number does it look like now?

prompt.en: Your house number is 7. How many claps will you clap for it?
prompt.hi: Tumhare ghar ka number 7 hai. Uske liye kitni taaliyaan bajaoge?

prompt.en: In cricket, a batter got out without scoring a single run. What is his score?
prompt.hi: Cricket mein ek batsman bina ek bhi run banaye out ho gaya. Uska score kya hai?

challenges.hint: Not even one. What number is that?

prompt.en: What number is "nau"?
prompt.hi: "Nau" kaun sa number hai?

challenges.hint: Count in Hindi: ek, do, teen...

prompt.en: Count backwards: 3, 2, 1, ___. What comes next?
prompt.hi: Ulta gino: 3, 2, 1, ___. Aage kya aayega?

prompt.en: 5 or 2 — which number is more?
prompt.hi: 5 ya 2 — kaun sa number zyada hai?

challenges.hint: Which one do you reach later when counting?

prompt.en: 3 or 6 — which number is less?
prompt.hi: 3 ya 6 — kaun sa number kam hai?

prompt.en: What is one more than 4?
prompt.hi: 4 se ek zyada kitna?

prompt.en: What is one less than 7?
prompt.hi: 7 se ek kam kitna?

prompt.en: 7 small mangoes or 4 big mangoes — which has more mangoes?
prompt.hi: 7 chhote aam ya 4 bade aam — kismein zyada aam hain?

prompt.en: Tenzin has 3 big footballs. Meenu has 5 small marbles. Who has more things?
prompt.hi: Tenzin ke paas 3 badi footballs hain. Meenu ke paas 5 chhote kanche. Zyada cheezein kiske paas hain?

challenges.hint: Forget the size. How many does each have?

prompt.en: You have ₹5. A toffee packet costs ₹8. Is your money enough?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹5 hain. Toffee ka packet ₹8 ka hai. Kya paise kaafi hain?

challenges.hint: Is what you have more or less than the price?

prompt.en: What comes just before 9?
prompt.hi: 9 se theek pehle kya aata hai?

prompt.en: Show 10 fingers. Fold 3 fingers down. How many are still up?
prompt.hi: 10 ungliyaan dikhao. 3 ungliyaan mod lo. Kitni khadi hain?

prompt.en: 8 and how many more make 10?
prompt.hi: 8 mein kitne aur milaayein to 10 banega?

prompt.en: 4 and how many more make 10?
prompt.hi: 4 mein kitne aur milaayein to 10 banega?

prompt.en: Bholu says 6 and 3 make 10. Check with your fingers. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Bholu kehta hai 6 aur 3 se 10 banta hai. Ungliyon se check karo. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A ten-frame has 10 boxes. 7 boxes have beads. How many boxes are empty?
prompt.hi: Ten-frame mein 10 khaane hain. 7 khaanon mein moti hain. Kitne khaane khaali hain?

challenges.hint: 7 are full. Count on from 7 to 10.

prompt.en: On a string of 10 beads, 4 are red and the rest are blue. How many are blue?
prompt.hi: 10 motiyon ki maala mein 4 laal hain, baaki neele. Kitne neele hain?

prompt.en: A box had 10 laddoos. Didi ate some and 4 are left. How many did she eat?
prompt.hi: Dabbe mein 10 laddoo the. Didi ne kuch kha liye aur 4 bache. Didi ne kitne khaaye?

prompt.en: Quick one: 9 and how many make 10?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao: 9 aur kitne se 10 banta hai?

prompt.en: One bundle of 10 sticks and 2 loose sticks. How many sticks?
prompt.hi: 10 teeliyon ka ek bandal aur 2 khuli teeliyaan. Kitni teeliyaan?

challenges.hint: Start at 10 and count the loose ones.

prompt.en: 17 is 1 ten and how many ones?
prompt.hi: 17 mein 1 das aur kitni ekaai?

prompt.en: For fourteen, {friendF} writes 14 and Sonu writes 41. Who is right?
prompt.hi: Fourteen ke liye {friendF} likhti hai 14 aur Sonu likhta hai 41. Kaun sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Which digit shows the ten, and where does it go?

prompt.en: An egg tray holds 10 eggs and it is full. 4 more eggs are in a bowl. How many eggs?
prompt.hi: Ande ki tray mein 10 ande aate hain aur woh bhari hai. 4 ande katori mein bhi hain. Kul kitne ande?

challenges.hint: Count on from 10 with the bowl eggs.

prompt.en: Show 18 using one full ten-frame and some extra counters. How many extra counters?
prompt.hi: 18 ko ek bhare ten-frame aur kuch extra counters se dikhao. Kitne extra counters?

prompt.en: Bholu says 19 means 1 stick and 9 sticks, so 10 sticks in all. What is wrong?
prompt.hi: Bholu kehta hai 19 matlab 1 teeli aur 9 teeli, yaani kul 10 teeliyaan. Kya galat hai?

prompt.en: Which is more: 13 or 18?
prompt.hi: Kaun zyada hai: 13 ya 18?

prompt.en: 20 is how many tens?
prompt.hi: 20 mein kitne das hain?

prompt.en: Papa brought a box of 10 laddoos and 6 loose laddoos. How many laddoos in all?
prompt.hi: Papa 10 laddoo ka ek dabba aur 6 khule laddoo laaye. Kul kitne laddoo?

challenges.hint: Count on from 10 with the loose laddoos.

prompt.en: 1 ten and 1 one make which number?
prompt.hi: 1 das aur 1 ekaai milkar kaun sa number?

prompt.en: 3 parrots are on a guava tree. 2 more come. How many parrots now?
prompt.hi: Amrood ke ped pe 3 tote hain. 2 aur aa gaye. Ab kitne tote?

challenges.hint: Start at 3 and count the 2 new ones.

prompt.en: 2 and 2 more make how many?
prompt.hi: 2 aur 2 milkar kitne?

prompt.en: Start at 6 and count on 2 more. Where do you land?
prompt.hi: 6 se shuru karo aur 2 aage gino. Kahan pahunche?

challenges.hint: The first new number after 6 is 7.

prompt.en: 4 + 3 = ___. What goes in the blank?
prompt.hi: 4 + 3 = ___. Khaali jagah mein kya aayega?

prompt.en: Which one is true: 5 = 2 + 3, or 5 = 2 + 2?
prompt.hi: Kaun sa sahi hai: 5 = 2 + 3, ya 5 = 2 + 2?

challenges.hint: = means both sides are the same amount.

prompt.en: Bholu does 5 + 3 by counting "5, 6, 7" and says 7. What went wrong?
prompt.hi: Bholu 5 + 3 karta hai, ginta hai "5, 6, 7" aur kehta hai 7. Kya galat hua?

challenges.hint: Did "5" count as one of the 3?

prompt.en: 3 people are sitting in an auto-rickshaw. 1 more gets in. How many people?
prompt.hi: Auto-rickshaw mein 3 log baithe hain. 1 aur baith gaya. Kitne log?

challenges.hint: One more joins. What is one more than 3?

prompt.en: In cricket you hit a 4, then you run 3 more runs. What is your score?
prompt.hi: Cricket mein tumne ek chauka maara, phir 3 run aur bhaage. Tumhara score kya hai?

challenges.hint: Then 3 more runs. Count on from 4.

prompt.en: 6 = 4 + ___. What number is missing?
prompt.hi: 6 = 4 + ___. Kaun sa number chhoot gaya?

prompt.en: 1 mango and 5 more mangoes. How many mangoes?
prompt.hi: 1 aam aur 5 aam aur. Kitne aam?

prompt.en: 5 rotis are on the plate. Bhaiya eats 2. How many rotis are left?
prompt.hi: Plate pe 5 rotiyaan hain. Bhaiya 2 kha leta hai. Kitni bachi?

challenges.hint: Fold 2 fingers from 5. How many are up?

prompt.en: You have 4 balloons. 1 pops. How many are left?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas 4 gubbare hain. 1 phoot gaya. Kitne bache?

prompt.en: Start at 7. Count back 3. Where are you now?
prompt.hi: 7 se shuru karo. 3 peeche gino. Ab kahan ho?

challenges.hint: The first number back from 7 is 6.

prompt.en: {friendF} has 5 bangles. Pooja has 3 bangles. How many more does {friendF} have?
prompt.hi: {friendF} ke paas 5 choodiyaan hain. Pooja ke paas 3. {friendF} ke paas kitni zyada hain?

challenges.hint: How many of {friendF}'s have no partner?

prompt.en: 2 + 3 = 5. So what is 5 − 3? How do you know without counting?
prompt.hi: 2 + 3 = 5. To 5 − 3 kitna? Bina gine kaise pata?

challenges.hint: If you take one part away, what is left?

prompt.en: Bholu says 3 − 5 = 2, just like 5 − 3. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Bholu kehta hai 3 − 5 = 2, bilkul 5 − 3 jaisa. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: 9 children are on the school bus. 4 get off at the first stop. How many are still on the bus?
prompt.hi: School bus mein 9 bachche hain. Pehle stop pe 4 utar gaye. Bus mein kitne bache?

prompt.en: Show 8 − 3 on a number line: start at 8 and jump back 3. Where do you land?
prompt.hi: 8 − 3 ko number line pe dikhao: 8 se shuru karo aur 3 jump peeche. Kahan pahunche?

challenges.hint: Jump back one at a time: first jump lands on 7.

prompt.en: Your team needs 7 runs to win. You have scored 4. How many more runs do you need?
prompt.hi: Team ko jeetne ke liye 7 run chahiye. Tumne 4 bana liye. Aur kitne run chahiye?

prompt.en: 4 mangoes. You eat 1. How many are left?
prompt.hi: 4 aam hain. Tumne 1 kha liya. Kitne bache?
10 + 4 kitna?

prompt.en: 8 tomatoes and 5 tomatoes. Fill the 10-crate first. How many in all?
prompt.hi: 8 tamatar aur 5 tamatar. Pehle 10 ka crate bharo. Kul kitne?

challenges.hint: Move 2 from the 5. How many are left?

prompt.hi: 7 + 6 kitna?

challenges.hint: Take 3 from the 6. What is left?

prompt.en: 10 + 6 and 6 + 10 — same or different?
prompt.hi: 10 + 6 aur 6 + 10 — ek jaise ya alag?

prompt.en: A train has 9 coaches. 5 more coaches are joined. How many coaches now?
prompt.hi: Ek train mein 9 dibbe hain. 5 aur dibbe jode gaye. Ab kitne dibbe?

challenges.hint: Take 1 from the 5. What is left?

prompt.en: You have ₹9 and Nani gives you ₹7. How much money do you have now?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹9 hain aur Nani ₹7 deti hain. Ab tumhare paas kitne paise hain?

challenges.hint: Take 1 from the 7. What is left?

prompt.en: 10 and 7 more make?
prompt.hi: 10 aur 7 milkar kitne?

prompt.en: The sabziwala has 15 brinjals. He sells 1. How many are left?
prompt.hi: Sabziwale ke paas 15 baingan hain. Usne 1 becha. Kitne bache?
16 − 6 kitna?

challenges.hint: Take away the 6 ones. What is still there?

prompt.en: 13 − 5: first take 3 to reach 10, then take 2 more. What is the answer?
prompt.hi: 13 − 5: pehle 3 hatao taaki 10 ho jaaye, phir 2 aur hatao. Jawaab kya?

prompt.en: Count back 3 from 12. Where do you land?
prompt.hi: 12 se 3 peeche gino. Kahan pahunche?

prompt.en: Bholu says 14 − 6 = 12 because 6 − 4 = 2. Check his answer.
prompt.hi: Bholu kehta hai 14 − 6 = 12, kyunki 6 − 4 = 2. Uska jawaab check karo.

prompt.en: 17 − 4 and 14 − 7: same answer or different?
prompt.hi: 17 − 4 aur 14 − 7: jawaab same hai ya alag?

prompt.en: The sabziwala had 15 brinjals and sold 6. How many are left?
prompt.hi: Sabziwale ke paas 15 baingan the, usne 6 beche. Kitne bache?

prompt.en: On a number line, start at 18 and jump back 5. Where do you land?
prompt.hi: Number line pe 18 se shuru karo aur 5 jump peeche. Kahan pahunche?

prompt.en: A bus has 20 seats. 12 people are sitting. How many seats are empty?
prompt.hi: Bus mein 20 seats hain. 12 log baithe hain. Kitni seats khaali hain?
19 − 9 kitna?

prompt.en: Two pencils are exactly the same. I push one forward a little. Guess: is one longer now?
prompt.hi: Do pencil bilkul ek jaisi hain. Main ek ko thoda aage khiska deti hoon. Guess karo: kya ab ek lambi hai?

challenges.hint: What happens if we line up their ends again?

prompt.en: Bholu put one stick on a step and a longer stick on the floor. He says the one on the step is taller. Is that fair?
prompt.hi: Bholu ne ek lakdi seedhi pe rakhi aur ek lambi lakdi zameen pe. Woh kehta hai seedhi wali lambi hai. Kya yeh theek tareeka hai?

challenges.hint: The step lifts one stick up.

prompt.en: A book is as long as 3 crayons laid end to end. How long is the book in crayons?
prompt.hi: Ek kitaab 3 crayon ek ke baad ek rakhne jitni lambi hai. Kitaab kitne crayon lambi hai?

prompt.en: You walk from the door to the bed: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 footsteps, heel touching toe. How long is it?
prompt.hi: Tum darwaaze se bistar tak chalte ho: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 kadam, aedi se panja milaakar. Kitni doori hai?

prompt.en: The corridor is 8 of your footsteps. The room is 6 of your footsteps. How many more steps is the corridor?
prompt.hi: Gali tumhare 8 kadam ki hai. Kamra tumhare 6 kadam ka. Gali kitne kadam zyada hai?

prompt.en: {friendF} says her room is 10 footsteps. Arjun says his room is 8 footsteps. Can we be sure {friendF}'s room is longer?
prompt.hi: {friendF} kehti hai uska kamra 10 kadam ka hai. Arjun kehta hai uska 8 kadam ka. Kya pakka hai ki {friendF} ka kamra lamba hai?

challenges.hint: Are their feet the same size?

prompt.en: On the balance, the mango side goes down. Which is heavier: the mango or the leaf on the other side?
prompt.hi: Taraazu mein aam wala palda neeche gaya. Bhaari kaun hai: aam ya doosri taraf ka patta?

challenges.hint: The heavier thing pulls its side...?

options.text: the leaf on the other side

prompt.en: Bholu sees the onion side go up and says the onion is heavier. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Bholu dekhta hai pyaaz wala palda upar gaya aur kehta hai pyaaz bhaari hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: The onion side went up. What does up mean?

prompt.en: Remember the pillow and the brick? Is the bigger thing always heavier?
prompt.hi: Takiya aur eent yaad hai? Kya badi cheez hamesha bhaari hoti hai?

prompt.en: 3 bundles of 10 bangles. How many bangles?
prompt.hi: 10-10 choodiyon ke 3 bandal. Kitni choodiyaan?

prompt.en: 7 bundles of ten and 2 loose sticks. What number is that?
prompt.hi: 10 ke 7 bandal aur 2 khuli teeliyaan. Yeh kaun sa number hai?

challenges.hint: 7 tens is 70. Then the loose ones.

prompt.en: 4 tens and 6 ones. Write the number.
prompt.hi: 4 das aur 6 ekaai. Number likho.

challenges.hint: Tens digit on the left, ones digit on the right.

prompt.en: Count by tens: 10, 20, 30, ___?
prompt.hi: Das-das karke gino: 10, 20, 30, ___?

prompt.en: Bholu wrote sixty-two as 602. What is wrong?
prompt.hi: Bholu ne sixty-two (baasath) ko 602 likha. Kya galat hai?

challenges.hint: How many digits does a tens-and-ones number need?

prompt.en: There are 6 trays of 10 eggs and 7 more eggs. How many eggs?
prompt.hi: 10-10 ande ki 6 trays aur 7 ande alag. Kul kitne ande?

challenges.hint: 6 tens is 60. Then the extra eggs.

prompt.en: Papa has 4 notes of ₹10 and 5 coins of ₹1. How much money is that?
prompt.hi: Papa ke paas ₹10 ke 4 note aur ₹1 ke 5 sikke hain. Kul kitne paise?

prompt.en: "Chhiyaalees" means 4 tens and 6 ones. Write it in numbers.
prompt.hi: "Chhiyaalees" matlab 4 das aur 6 ekaai. Isse number mein likho.

prompt.en: Two tens and five ones — say its name.
prompt.hi: Do das aur paanch ekaai — iska naam bolo.

prompt.en: What comes just after 39?
prompt.hi: 39 ke theek baad kya aata hai?

challenges.hint: 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten.

prompt.en: What number comes between 56 and 58?
prompt.hi: 56 aur 58 ke beech mein kaun sa number hai?

prompt.en: 20 and 29: which comes first when counting?
prompt.hi: 20 aur 29: ginte waqt pehle kaun aata hai?

challenges.hint: Which one did you say first?

prompt.en: Bholu counts: 27, 28, 29, twenty-ten. What should come after 29?
prompt.hi: Bholu ginta hai: 27, 28, 29, twenty-ten. 29 ke baad kya aana chahiye?

challenges.hint: Ten ones make a new ten.

prompt.en: Write "sixty-eight" in numbers.
prompt.hi: "Sixty-eight" (adsath) ko number mein likho.

prompt.en: Your counter is on 45 on the 100-grid. You move one row down. Where are you now?
prompt.hi: 100-grid pe tumhaari goti 45 pe hai. Tum ek row neeche jaate ho. Ab kahan ho?

prompt.en: At the clinic, token 59 is being called. Your token is the next one. What is your token number?
prompt.hi: Clinic mein token 59 bulaaya ja raha hai. Tumhara token agla hai. Tumhara token number kya hai?

challenges.hint: 59 and one more makes a new ten.

prompt.en: What comes just before 70?
prompt.hi: 70 se theek pehle kya aata hai?

challenges.hint: 70 is 7 tens. One less breaks a ten.

prompt.en: "Pachaas" is which number?
prompt.hi: "Pachaas" kaun sa number hai?

challenges.hint: Count in tens in Hindi: das, bees, tees...

prompt.en: Red-blue-red-blue and clap-jump-clap-jump: are they the same kind of pattern?
prompt.hi: Laal-neela-laal-neela aur taali-kood-taali-kood: kya yeh ek hi tarah ke pattern hain?

challenges.hint: Do both go "this, that, this, that"?

prompt.en: Is this a pattern: red, red, blue, green, blue, red?
prompt.hi: Kya yeh pattern hai: laal, laal, neela, hara, neela, laal?

challenges.hint: Does red, red, blue come again?

prompt.en: {friendF}'s mala: red, blue, red, blue, red, blue, blue, blue. She says it is a pattern all the way. Is it?
prompt.hi: {friendF} ki maala: laal, neela, laal, neela, laal, neela, neela, neela. Woh kehti hai poori maala pattern hai. Kya sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Check the end: after blue, what should come?

prompt.en: Is "clap, jump, clap, jump" a pattern?
prompt.hi: Kya "taali, kood, taali, kood" ek pattern hai?

prompt.en: When do we sleep: in the morning or at night?
prompt.hi: Hum kab sote hain: subah ya raat ko?

challenges.hint: When do you go to bed?

prompt.en: "Take a bath after you play." Which comes first, the bath or playing?
prompt.hi: "Khelne ke baad naha lena." Pehle kya hoga, nahaana ya khelna?

prompt.en: The sun is going down and the sky is orange. Guess what comes next: night or morning?
prompt.hi: Sooraj doob raha hai aur aasmaan naarangi hai. Guess karo aage kya aayega: raat ya subah?

prompt.en: What comes first: taking a bath or getting dressed?
prompt.hi: Pehle kya aata hai: nahaana ya kapde pehenna?

prompt.en: Three plates have 2, 2 and 2 laddoos. Is there the same number on each plate?
prompt.hi: 3 plates pe 2, 2 aur 2 laddoo hain. Kya har plate pe barabar hain?

challenges.hint: Are all the numbers the same?

prompt.en: 2 plates, 2 laddoos on each. How many laddoos?
prompt.hi: 2 plates, har plate pe 2 laddoo. Kitne laddoo?

prompt.en: 3 auto-rickshaws, 3 wheels on each. How many wheels?
prompt.hi: 3 auto-rickshaw, har ek mein 3 pahiye. Kitne pahiye?

prompt.en: 4 + 4 + 4. How many groups of 4 is that?
prompt.hi: 4 + 4 + 4. Isme 4 ke kitne group hain?

prompt.en: Bholu has 3 plates with 4 laddoos each. He says 3 + 4 = 7 laddoos. What is wrong?
prompt.hi: Bholu ke paas 3 plates hain, har ek pe 4 laddoo. Woh kehta hai 3 + 4 = 7 laddoo. Kya galat hai?

prompt.en: 2 cows, each has 4 legs. How many legs?
prompt.hi: 2 gaayein, har ek ki 4 taangein. Kitni taangein?

prompt.en: Each child eats 2 rotis. 4 children eat. How many rotis must be made?
prompt.hi: Har bachcha 2 roti khaata hai. 4 bachche khaate hain. Kitni rotiyaan banani padengi?

prompt.en: 3 plates, 2 bananas on each. How many bananas?
prompt.hi: 3 plates, har plate pe 2 kele. Kitne kele?

prompt.en: Count in twos: 2, 4, 6, ___?
prompt.hi: Do-do karke gino: 2, 4, 6, ___?

prompt.en: Count in fives: 5, 10, 15, ___?
prompt.hi: Paanch-paanch karke gino: 5, 10, 15, ___?

prompt.en: There are 4 pairs of chappals outside the temple. Count in twos. How many chappals?
prompt.hi: Mandir ke bahar chappal ke 4 jode hain. Do-do karke gino. Kitni chappal?

prompt.en: {friendF} and Sonu hold up both hands — that is 4 hands. Count in fives. How many fingers?
prompt.hi: {friendF} aur Sonu dono haath upar karte hain — 4 haath. Paanch-paanch karke gino. Kitni ungliyaan?

prompt.en: "Three twos" and "2 + 2 + 2" — same or different?
prompt.hi: "Teen do" aur "2 + 2 + 2" — ek jaise ya alag?

prompt.en: Bholu counts in twos: 2, 4, 6, 7, 8. Which number is wrong?
prompt.hi: Bholu do-do karke ginta hai: 2, 4, 6, 7, 8. Kaun sa number galat hai?

prompt.en: 5 children, 2 eyes each. Count in twos. How many eyes?
prompt.hi: 5 bachche, har ek ki 2 aankhein. Do-do karke gino. Kitni aankhein?

prompt.en: Toffees cost ₹5 each. You buy 4. Count in fives: how much do you pay?
prompt.hi: Ek toffee ₹5 ki hai. Tum 4 kharidte ho. Paanch-paanch karke gino: kitne paise doge?

prompt.en: Counting chappals: "2, 4, 6". Arjun says there are 3 chappals. Fatima says there are 6. Who is right?
prompt.hi: Chappal gin rahe hain: "2, 4, 6". Arjun kehta hai 3 chappal hain. Fatima kehti hai 6. Kaun sahi hai?

prompt.en: Which coin is worth more: ₹2 or ₹5?
prompt.hi: Kaun sa sikka zyada keemat ka hai: ₹2 ya ₹5?

challenges.hint: Look at the number on each coin.

prompt.en: Three ₹1 coins or one ₹5 coin — which is more money?
prompt.hi: ₹1 ke 3 sikke ya ₹5 ka ek sikka — zyada paise kaun se hain?

prompt.en: Make ₹10 using only ₹5 coins. How many coins do you need?
prompt.hi: Sirf ₹5 ke sikkon se ₹10 banao. Kitne sikke chahiye?

prompt.en: A pencil costs ₹5. You have two ₹2 coins and one ₹1 coin. Is that enough?
prompt.hi: Pencil ₹5 ki hai. Tumhare paas ₹2 ke do sikke aur ₹1 ka ek sikka hai. Kya kaafi hai?

prompt.en: A ₹10 note or a ₹2 coin: which buys more?
prompt.hi: ₹10 ka note ya ₹2 ka sikka: kisse zyada khareed sakte ho?

prompt.en: ₹5 and ₹5 make how much?
prompt.hi: ₹5 aur ₹5 milkar kitne?

prompt.en: A balloon costs ₹5. You have ₹10. Can you buy it?
prompt.hi: Gubbara ₹5 ka hai. Tumhare paas ₹10 hain. Kya le sakte ho?

challenges.hint: If you have more than the price...

prompt.en: You have ₹10. The balloon costs ₹5. How much money is left?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹10 hain. Gubbara ₹5 ka hai. Kitne paise bachenge?

prompt.en: A toffee costs ₹3 and you have ₹5. Can you buy it?
prompt.hi: Toffee ₹3 ki hai aur tumhare paas ₹5 hain. Kya khareed sakte ho?

challenges.hint: If you pay more, what does the shopkeeper give back?

prompt.en: You have ₹10 at the mela. You buy a ₹5 balloon. What else can you buy: a ₹4 whistle or a ₹7 car?
prompt.hi: Mele mein tumhare paas ₹10 hain. Tum ₹5 ka gubbara lete ho. Aur kya le sakte ho: ₹4 ki seeti ya ₹7 ki gaadi?

prompt.en: You have ₹10. A balloon is ₹6 and a whistle is ₹5. Guess: can you buy both?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹10 hain. Gubbara ₹6 ka aur seeti ₹5 ki. Guess karo: kya dono le sakte ho?

prompt.en: Bholu had ₹10 and bought a ₹7 kite. He says he has no money left. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Bholu ke paas ₹10 the aur usne ₹7 ki patang li. Woh kehta hai ab koi paise nahi bache. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: At the sabzi shop you have ₹20. Tomatoes cost ₹12. How much change do you get?
prompt.hi: Sabzi ki dukaan pe tumhare paas ₹20 hain. Tamatar ₹12 ke hain. Kitne paise wapas milenge?

prompt.en: You have ₹9 and spend ₹4. Show what is left using coins.
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹9 hain aur tum ₹4 kharch karte ho. Bache hue paise sikkon se dikhao.

challenges.hint: Which coin is worth that much?

prompt.en: You have ₹10 and spend ₹3. How much is left?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹10 hain aur tum ₹3 kharch karte ho. Kitne bache?

prompt.en: The toy box has: car, doll, car, ball, doll, car. How many cars?
prompt.hi: Khilone ke dabbe mein hai: gaadi, gudiya, gaadi, ball, gudiya, gaadi. Kitni gaadiyaan?

prompt.en: We are sorting toys by type: cars, dolls, balls. A red ball goes in the balls group. Should we count it again in a red-toys group too?
prompt.hi: Hum khilonon ko type se alag kar rahe hain: gaadi, gudiya, ball. Laal ball, ball wale group mein gayi. Kya use ek laal-khilonon wale group mein dobara bhi ginein?

challenges.hint: Is there a red-toys group in a sort by type?

prompt.en: Bholu counted 4 cars, 2 dolls and 3 balls. He says there are 8 toys in all. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Bholu ne gini 4 gaadiyaan, 2 gudiyaan aur 3 ball. Woh kehta hai kul 8 khilone hain. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: 4 cars and 2 dolls. How many more cars than dolls?
prompt.hi: 4 gaadiyaan aur 2 gudiyaan. Gudiyon se kitni zyada gaadiyaan hain?

challenges.hint: How many cars have no partner?

prompt.en: A basket has: mango, apple, mango, mango, apple. How many mangoes?
prompt.hi: Ek tokri mein hai: aam, seb, aam, aam, seb. Kitne aam?

prompt.en: A row of 4 big car pictures is longer than a row of 5 small doll pictures. Which has more?
prompt.hi: 4 badi gaadi ki tasveeron wali line, 5 chhoti gudiya wali line se lambi hai. Kismein zyada hain?

challenges.hint: Count each row instead of looking at length.

prompt.en: There are 6 balls in the box. Bholu drew 3 balls on the chart. What is wrong?
prompt.hi: Dabbe mein 6 ball hain. Bholu ne chart pe 3 ball banayi. Kya galat hai?

challenges.hint: How many pictures should there be?

prompt.en: Stack one block for each car. There are 4 cars. How many blocks tall is the stack?
prompt.hi: Har gaadi ke liye ek block rakho. 4 gaadiyaan hain. Stack kitne block ooncha hoga?

prompt.en: Chart: cars 4, dolls 2, balls 3. How many more cars than dolls?
prompt.hi: Chart: gaadiyaan 4, gudiyaan 2, ball 3. Gudiyon se kitni zyada gaadiyaan?

challenges.hint: Match each doll picture with a car picture.
